## Checklist

- [ ] Every new or changed figure has a source in `data/sources.csv` (link, and page/table/column in `note` or `locator`)
- [ ] `evidence` is honest: `downloaded` or `page_opened` only if I read the figure in the source myself
- [ ] New official files are in `data/official/`, unchanged, with their SHA-256 registered, and their licence allows redistribution
- [ ] `python data/check_data.py` passes
- [ ] Generated files (`taiwan_timeseries.csv`, `data/fleet/`, `docs/data/`) were rebuilt with their script, not edited by hand
- [ ] Website text: English and Chinese kept in step (if changed)
- [ ] No credentials, personal data or model outputs
